title: I Hate You
lyrics:
[00:13.05]Some things are still stuck inside my head
[00:19.72]Some days are still better than the rest
[00:26.02]I started to like you less and less
[00:32.14]And since we met, my life's been a mess
[00:37.53]I hate you, you're the worst best friend I ever had
[00:43.84]So thank you, 'cause nothing else could be that bad
[00:50.14]I embrace you and all you did was stab me in the back
[00:56.44]So thank you, 'cause now all I can do is laugh
[01:03.82]You only like to talk about yourself
[01:10.21]Do you ever think about anything else?
[01:16.15]You never bother to ask me how I felt
[01:22.54]You were too busy staring in the mirror at yourself
[01:28.11]I hate you, you're the worst best friend I ever had
[01:34.33]So thank you, 'cause nothing else could be that bad
[01:40.62]I embrace you and all you did was stab me in the back
[01:46.92]So thank you, 'cause now all I can do is laugh
[01:54.06]I think that we both need closure
[01:59.99]Don't ask if I'm coming over
[02:06.39]I'd rather stay here stuck inside my head
[02:12.60]You've only filled me with a whole lot of regret
[02:18.45]I hate you, you're the worst best friend I ever had
[02:24.84]So thank you, 'cause nothing else could be that bad
[02:31.14]I embrace you and all you did was stab me in the back
[02:37.43]So thank you, 'cause now all I can do is laugh
